<subject>Need some help</subject>
<body>
Shane, 
Do you know if Lakeshore Utilities is hiring for IT people? My brother-in-law just graduated with a degree in Information Systems and is looking for a job after the summer. He is finishing up his final courses this summer. He was saying he wanted to work with our Utility Customer Information System...whatever that means. And our Meter Data Management system, whatever that is too. Can you help me out please.
</body>
